newsitem.title: USA: Moyco sues Cabot over patent.
newsitem.headline: Moyco sues Cabot over patent.

text.p: Moyco Technologies Inc said it filed a lawsuit on Wednesday against Cabot Corp, alleging that a Cabot patent was invalid.

The civil suit, which seeks a declaratory judgment, alleged that Cabot's patent on a chemical mechanical polishing slurry was invalid, and that Cabot improperly interfered with contractual relationships between Moyco and third parties.
A Cabot spokeswoman said the company would not comment on litigation.
The suit was filed Wednesday in the U.S. district court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, Moyco said.
Moyco said it is seeking damages from alleged unfair competition and patent misuse by Cabot.
Moyco said it believes Cabot intentionally attempted to break an existing publicly announced agreement between Moyco and Nanophase Technologies Corp.
Moyco is a manufacturer of precision abrasives, CMP materials, and professional dental supplies.
For purposes of manufacturing CMP slurries, Moyco retains exclusive rights to alumina and ceria feedstocks manufactured by Nanophase via a patented process.
